tutorial.texto: I'll walk you through the whole app, holding your hand. Enjoy it: it's the only time anyone will hold your hand.
This is what the accounts you follow post. Pull down from the top to refresh. If nothing shows up, it's not a bug: nobody thought of you.
Tap someone's picture or name to see their profile. Stalking is free. Dignity isn't.
Double tap a photo to like it with a giant heart. If it has dots below, it's a carousel: swipe sideways to see the rest.
The heart likes and unlikes. It's the closest you'll get to touching someone this month.
The bubble opens the post so you can comment. Two comments per post, tops: after the third it stops being interest and becomes a case file.
The arrow really shares to your socials. Your contacts will know what you play. Start preparing the explanation.
The circles on a profile are story highlights; the pinned one always goes first. Inside, tap the middle to like or press and hold to unleash a burst of hearts. Desperate, but stylish.
Every profile keeps photos apart from thoughts. On yours, «Likes» keeps everything you ever liked. Other people's likes are private; yours, not so much.
Your chats. The ones you left on read too. Especially those.
Your photos, your thoughts and, in «Likes», everything you ever liked. You don't remember; Boringram does. Boringram never forgets.
Pull the top bar down to see your notifications. It's mostly spam. Like your inbox. Like your relationships.
If you get lost, replay the tour from here. There's no button for getting lost in life. We asked, but it wasn't profitable.
Now you know how to use Boringram. Time to waste time like a pro.
